I'm your host, Darren Van Dam!

What if a movie didn’t just tell a good story—but pulled you inside and made you a main character?

In this video, I’m breaking down a unique list of films that actually make YOU like the main character, whether through highly immersive POV filmmaking, real-time storytelling, psychological manipulation, or by forcing you into the moral center of the story. Some of these movies place you directly in the character’s shoes. Others quietly turn you, the viewer, into the most important participant in the room. Either way, these films don’t let you passively watch. You're an active participant in these films whether you want to be, or not.

If you’re looking for mind-bending movies, immersive thrillers, or films that break traditional storytelling rules, this list is for you.Thanks
title: You Don't Just Watch These Movies... You're In Them
